༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi man ngag zab don rgya mtsho'i khog dbub sa bcad 'dus don don gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhugs so/ /rin chen shog skya'i sa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi man ngag zab don rgya mtsho'i

khog dbub sa bcad 'dus don don gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhugs so/ / rin chen shog skya'i skor las/ āoṃ swa sti/ chos spyi mthun gyi khungs btsun yid ches pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba sku gsum rim bzhin 'phro tshul bshad/ don ji bzhin kho thag chod phyir bar do gsum na rim bzhin ngos gzung bshad/ 'khrul grol skyon yon gyi shan 'byed phyir gzhi dang gzhi snang las ma dag glo bur 'khrul tshul bstan/ lam mthar zad gzigs snang las 'das te rnam grol gyi yon tan shes bya'i rnam pa rang ngor thob ste btsan sa zin tshul bstan/ rtags yid ches bskyed phyir gnad mngon sum gyis rim bzhin sprod tshul bstan/ mngon sum gyi man ngag gnad du zab phyir kun gyi 'khrul ma myong bar ngo 'phrod de grol ba thob tshul bstan/ de mngon sum rang dbang thob phyir sa brgyad kyi sems dpa' gcig gi khong du chud tshul bstan/ yul gdul bya spro ba bskyed phyir dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsam ste yi ge bkod tshul bstan/ tshul 'di bzhin dgos la don yin bzhin ma nor ba gal che'o/ /yang sku gsum gyi phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad pa rnams kyang*/ phyi gnyen po'am mthun 'jug gi thabs gtso bor dgongs pa dang*/ nang ngo bo ngos gzung che tshul dang*/ gsang ba mtshan nyid kyi chos la bzhag ste/ gnad ma 'phyugs pa gal che'o/ /rdzogs so// //dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che'i mkhyen rab dpag bsam shing*/ /phan bde'i rang bzhin me tog 'bras mang ldan/ / thugs rje'i bsil grib shin tu rgya che bas/ /'gro blo'i gdung skyob mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i mkha' la bdud rtsi'i sprin 'khrigs pas/ /byams pa'i 'brug sgra snying rje'i glog phreng can/ /zhi bde'i chos char shin tu rmad byung bas/ /dge legs bsam 'phel mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yul ring dus nas srid pa'i sems can la/ /zhi ba'i don ston thar par 'dren pa'i lha/

/ bde gshegs rig 'dzin padma thod phreng dang*/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag blo'i skye tshal yangs shing rgya che ba/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig dpag bsam rgyas pa'i mthus/ /de yi don 'dril dngos grub ljon pa'i shing*/ /zab cing rgya che'i yal 'dab rgyas par spro/ /dpal ldan gangs ri'i tshal na dga' ba'i blo/ /shin tu rmad byung gtsug gi nor bu'i tog /srid las rnam grol lha yi dpag bsam shing*/ /yid mkha'i tshal du yid 'ong bzang dgus brgyan/ /de slad skal ldan byang chub chos 'dod rnams/ /theg mchog snying po'i dngos grub zhing 'dir bstan/ /legs pa'i me tog rin chen char phab cing*/ /srid gsum gdung skyob tshe 'dir 'bras bu 'thob/ /theg pa'i nang nas yang rab bla na med/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po kun gyi rtse/ / gsang ba las kyang ches gsang rmad byung 'di/ /skal ldan srid pa tha ma'i dam chos lags/ /'di dang su 'phrad myur du grol nges pas/ /'bras bu'i dam chos bdud rtsi chen po 'di/ /o rgyan padma'i zab gter kun gyi mchog /'di nyid deng sang gdul bya'i yid mkhar babs/ /de phyir don gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer bri/ /de la 'dir mkhas pa chen po klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i zab don rgya mtsho 'di la spyi don gsum ste/ /klad don dang*/ gzhung don dang*/ mjug don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan dang*/ phyag dang*/ dam bca'o/ / phyag la gnyis te/ spyi dang bye brag go /dam bca' ba la gnyis te/ brtsams tshul dang*/ dam bca' dngos so/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid bdun gyis gdams pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu bstan pa dang*/ /phun sum tshogs pa lngas gleng gzhi'i gdams pa mdor bstan pa/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi gdams pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bdun te/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ ji ltar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ grogs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/

yo byad kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ dus kyi mtshan nyid do/ /dang po la gnyis te/ blang bya dang*/ dor bya'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar bstan pa la gsum ste/ zang zing dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sgrub pas mnyes par bya ba'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa phun sum tshogs pa lngas gleng gzhi'i gdams pa mdor bstan pa la gnyis te/ thun mong gi gling gzhi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ chos sku dang*/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku'i gleng gzhi'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ gnas dang*/ ston pa dang*/ 'khor dang*/ chos dang*/ dus so/ /gnyis pa longs sku la lnga ste/ rnam par snang mdzad gang chen mtsho dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa'o/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i gleng gzhi la gnyis te/ lha yul drug dang*/ mi yul du byon tshul drug go /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi la gsum ste/ gzhi 'dug tshul gyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ lam nyams su blang pa dang*/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ /bar pa la gnyis te/ gnas pa'i lus kyi dang*/ 'char ba'i yul gyis so/ /spyi don gsum pa gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi gdams pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ dang po gzhi'i gnas lugs bstan pa/ bar du lam gyi khyer tshul bstan pa/ tha ma 'bras bu'i grol tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ 'khor 'das gang du'ang ma grub pa'i sngon rol na gzhi gshis kyi gnas lugs bstan pa dang*/ de las lhun grub kyi 'char tshul bstan pa/ de nyid rig pa thog ma'i kun tu bzang po'i gzhi thog tu ji ltar grol tshul/ ma rig pa khams gsum gyi sems can 'khor bar ji ltar 'khyams tshul/ sems can gyi khams la gdod ma'i sangs rgyas ji ltar bzhugs tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gdod ma'i gshis kyi 'dug tshul 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi byed tshul/ de la rtsod pa spangs tshul lo/

/dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ ngo bo/ rang bzhin/ thugs rje'o/ gnyis pa 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhi byed tshul la gnyis te/ dpe dang*/ don no/ de la gnyis te/ ma dag pa dang*/ dag pa'o/ /gsum pa rtsod pa spong ba la gsum ste/ snang mi snang yang rta ོ gas nas mi 'thad pa spang pa dang*/ gcig dang tha dad la dang*/ 'khrul ma 'khrul la'o/ /gnyis pa lhun grub kyi 'char tshul la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ ye shes de gang du 'char ba'i dpe nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ spyir na dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /de la bzhi ste/ lhun grub rin po che'i snang ba dang*/ gzhi snang chen po'i 'char lugs dang*/ longs sku dang*/ sprul sku'i 'char lugs so/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ 'char lugs rnam pa drug /sgo rnam pa gnyis yon tan yod tshul/ byung tshul rnam pa dgu'o/ /bzhi pa sprul sku la gsum ste/ rang bzhin dang*/ 'gro 'dul dang*/ ma dag sprul sku'o/ /gsum pa kun bzang gi grol tshul la gsum ste/ rtogs tshul dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ don mdzad tshul lo/ /spyi don bzhi pa ma rig pas sems can gyi 'khrul tshul la gsum ste/ khams gsum du 'khrul tshul mdor bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu lus grub tshul rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ kun gzhi la las sog tshul gyi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'khrul pa phyi ltar bshad pa dang*/ nang ltar dang*/ gsang ba ltar ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu lus grub tshul la gsum ste/ bkod pa lus kyi cha lugs kyis mdor bstan/ gnas pa rtsa thig rlung gsum gyis rgyas par bshad/ gnyis med ye shes chen pos don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rtsa ye shes 'dra ba'i gnas lugs bstan pa/ rlung rin chen 'od 'phro/ khams bde chen rgya mtsho'i gnas lugs so/ /gnyis pa rlung chen 'od 'phro la gsum ste/ rang bzhin ye shes kyi rlung ngos gzung ba/

de'i gdangs las kyi rlung mdor bstan pa/ de'i bye brag dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o/ dang po la gnyis te/ ngo bo ngos gzung ba dang*/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa kun gzhi la las sog tshul la gsum ste/ kun gzhi dang tshogs brgyad kyi dbye ba bstan/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dbye ba bstan/ /las gsum gyi sog tshul brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dang po 'khor bar grub tshul gyis dang*/ bar du las sogs tshul dang*/ tha ma 'khrul pa ldog tshul gyis so/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ dge ba/ mi dge ba/ mi g.yo ba'i las so// bsam gtan bzhi'i sems ji ltar skye tshul/ /gol ma gol gyi khyad par bshad tshul/ yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro tshul bshad/ /don lnga pa sems can gyi khams la gdod ma'i sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul la gsum ste/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bzhugs tshul mdor bstan/ sems ye shes kyi dbye ba bzhugs tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ de nyid 'khor 'das kyi rten byed tshul gyis don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ snying po ye shes kyi bzhugs tshul/ de'i mdangs sems kyi bzhugs tshul/ de gnyis ji ltar 'phrad cing gyais tshul lo/ dang po la gsum ste/ 'od gsum gyis ngo bor rgyas par bshad/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyis rang bzhin dang*/ rlung shes rab sku gsum gyi thugs rje'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ phyi ltar sku dang sbyar nas zhi khro'i skur gnas tshul/ nang ltar gsung dang sbyar bas 'khor lo lnga nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro yi ger grub tshul/ gsang ba thugs dang sbyar nas snying po 'od gsal spros pa dang bral ba'i thig ler gnas tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gnas dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dpe'o/ /ngo bo la gsum ste/ ngo bo sku ru bzhugs tshul/ rang bzhin 'od dang thig ler/ thugs rje sgron mar ro/ / gnyis pa gdangs sems la gsum ste/ sems gnas khams ngo bo gsum gyis spyir bstan/

ye shes kyi gdangs yin tshul gyis bye brag tu bshad/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du ji ltar bzhugs tshul gyis don bsdu ba'o/ / gsum pa ji ltar 'phrad cing gyes pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ da lta 'phrad tshul dang*/ phyis gyes tshul lo/ /de la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug go /spyi don gnyis pa bar du lam gyi khyer tshul la gnyis te/ smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed gdams pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ bskur ba'i yon tan/ ma bskur ba'i skyon/ rig pa dang dngos/ dam tshig go /bzhi pa dbang bskur ba dngos la lnga ste/ spros bcas/ sprod med/ shin tu spros med/ rab tu spros med/ bla med rtsal dbang ngo*/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ma thob pa thob par bya ba/ thob pa rgyud la brten pa'o/ /don gnyis pa grol byed gdams pa la gnyis te yid ches pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ma bshad pa'i skyon/ bshad pa'i yon tan/ bshad pa dngos so/ /gnyis pa gdams pa la gsum ste/ brtson 'grus rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ 'bring bar dor/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag go /dang po la bzhi ste/ sngon 'gro'i rim pa ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul/ dngos kyis zag pa med pa'i ye shes rgyud la brta ེ na pa'i tshul/ rjes su snang ba bzhi'i 'char tshul/ mtha' brten gyi man ngag bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ thun mong chos spyi'i sngon 'gro/ /thun mong ma yin pa rang gi sngon 'gro dang*/ gnas lugs kyi ngo bo khregs chod gdab tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ma rig pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byams sems de la bdun no/ /gnyis pa rang gi sngon 'gro la gsum ste/ phyi lus ngag yid gsum ru shan dbye zhing sngon du 'gro ba/ nang lus ngag yid gsum ru shan dbye zhing sgrib pa sbyang ba/ gsang ba lus ngag yid gsum rnal du dbab cing sor bzhag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/

lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid do/ /dang po la gnyis ste/ ru shan dbye ba dang*/ sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa ngag la yang gnyis te/ dngos dang sngon 'gro'o/ /de la bzhi ste/ rgyas gdab/ rtsal sbyang*/ mnyen btsal/ lam zhug go /gsum pa yid la gnyis te/ dngos dang sngon 'gro'o/ /de la gsum ste/ byung gnas/ 'gro gsum brtag pa'o/ / gsum pa khregs chod la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro gsum gyis zhi lhag zung 'jug gi gnas lugs ma skyes par skye bar bya ba/ dngos gzhi gsum gyis skyes pa ngo sprad par bya ba/ rjes rang grol gsum gyis skyes pa bogs dbyung zhing rtsal sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dang po rtog pa rtsad bcad/ bar du sems kyi mtshang btsal/ tha ma byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi mtha' brtag pa'o// gnyis pa ngo sprad la gsum ste/ gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du shar ba/ 'phro ba sems kyi rol par shar ba/ gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du gnas pa'o// gsum pa rtsal sbyang ba la gsum ste/ dug gsum rang grol/ sgo lnga/ tshogs drug go /don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro zag med kyi ye shes rgyud la skye ba'i tshul/ dngos gzhi de nyid ngo sprad pa/ rjes rnal 'byor bzhis nyams su blang tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba btang tshul/ sgo gsum gyi gnad gzir tshul/ ye shes gsum gyi gsang lam mtshon tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems so/ gsum pa gsang lam la gsum ste/ sgo'i gnad/ yul gyi gnad/ rlung rig gi gnad do/ /gnyis pa ngo sprad la gsum sta ེ / sku gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ lnga tshan bdun du ngo sprad do/ /gsum pa nyams su blang tshul la bzhi ste/ lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la drug/ ngo bo/ rdzogs tshul/ nges tshig/dbye ba/ nyams su blang tshul/ mtshan no/ gsum pa snang ba'i 'char tshul la bzhi ste/ chos nyid mngon sum dang*/ nyams gong 'phel dang*/

rig pa tshad phebs/ chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba'o/ /bdun pa la gnyis te/ shes nyams dang*/ snang nyams so/ /bzhi pa mtha' brten la bzhi ste/ mi 'gul ba gsum gyis gzhi bca'/ sdod pa gsum gyis tshad gzung*/ thob pa gsum gyis gzer gdab/ /gad ི nga bzhis grol tshad bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ lus/ mig dbying rig go /'di la tshad rmi lam gyis gzung*/ rtags lus ngag sems las 'byung ngo*/ /gsum pa thob pa la gsum ste/ skye ba/ 'jug pa/ rlung sems so/ /bzhi pa gad ི nga bzhi la bzhi ste/ yar gnyis/ mar gnyis/ gnyis pa 'bring la gnyis te/ bar do spyi'i rnam gzhag /bye brag nyams su blang thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams/ gnas lugs/ snang lugs so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ skye gnas kyi bar do la the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa rgya khra tshang du 'jug pa'am/ ded dpon gser gling du 'gro ba lta bu'i gdams ngag /'chi kha bar do mi gsal ba gsal gdab pa sgeg mo me long la blta ba'am/ rgyal po'i bka' 'phrin bskur ba lta bu'i gdams ngag /chos nyid bar do la rang snang la yid ches pa chom po grogs dang 'phrad pa'am/ ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bu dang*/ srid pa bar do la las kyi 'phro mthud pa yur ba rkang chad pa la wa 'dzugs pa lta bu'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ sbrul mdud nam mkha' la grol ba dang*/ mtsho nang du kha babs pa dang*/ 'khyags rom chur zhu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la snying sdug mdza' bo mthong ba dang*/ me long la byed bzhin gsal ba/ khab mi

ga tu skud pa 'dzud pa'o/ /gsum pa bum pa chag pa dang*/ seng ge'i gsob mthong ba dang*/ 'bras kyi ljang pa lta bu'o/ /'di la gsum ste/ 'jug pa shes pa dang*/ grol ba lus/ mthar phyin pa ngo shes pa'i gnad do/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la gsum ste/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang*/ zhar la yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ dang po la gsum ste/ sa'i non tshul/ sangs rgyas tshul/ rtags 'byung tshul lo/ /gnyis pa mthar thug la gsum ste/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'o/ /yang sku gsum thugs yon tan phrin las so/ /gsum pa la gsum ste/ zab gter gyi phan yon bstan pa/ gter 'byung gi lo rgyus bshad pa/ skyon dang bral ba'i phan yon/ /smon lam gyi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ phan yon dngos bshad pa/ chos kyi che ba brjod pa/ lta ba'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ mthong grol khyad par du 'phags pa'i phan yon dang*/ dge sdig phan gnod dang bral ba'i/ 'di las gzhan gyis mi grol ba'i/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i/ mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyong ba'i phan yon no/ /gnyis pa gter 'byung gi lo rgyus la gsum ste/ ston pa dang*/ bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa spyir bstan/ bsdu ba po gnas phun sum tshogs pa bye brag tu bshad/ dus dang skal ldan phun sum tshogs pa rgya cher bsngags pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa mjug don la gsum ste/ brtsams tshul bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ bdag gzhan zhi bar smon tshul dang*/ brtsams pa rdzogs tshul lo/ /man ngag zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin zhes bya ba'i sa bcad bsdus don don gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (7)mkha' 'gro snying tig gi man ngag zab don rgya mtsho'i khog dbub don gsal nyi ma'i 'od zer/ -PAGE 190--PAGE 189--PAGE 180-
